strings.zh: 你好,请允许我{NEWLINE}稍微耽误一下您的时间。{SCROLL}这前面有个度假区,{NEWLINE}集娱乐、休闲、购物、对战、捕捉于一体,{CLEAR}是非常适合训练家们放松的地方。{CLEAR}将来建成之后您一定要去看看啊！
strings.en: Hello! May I take a moment of your time?{SCROLL}Up ahead is the Resort Zone,{NEWLINE}with entertainment, leisure,{CLEAR}shopping, battling and catching{CLEAR}all in one place. It’s the perfect{CLEAR}spot for Trainers to relax.{SCROLL}Be sure to visit once it’s finished!
strings.notes: #0 before / #1 after the Resort Zone opens; signs #10/#11 likewise.

strings.zh: 你好,请允许我{NEWLINE}稍微耽误一下您的时间。{SCROLL}这前面有个度假区,{NEWLINE}集娱乐、休闲、购物、对战、捕捉于一体,{CLEAR}是非常适合训练家们放松的地方。{CLEAR}现在已经正式开业了,{CLEAR}您如果有时间的话,{CLEAR}就去那里看看吧！
strings.en: Hello! May I take a moment of your time?{SCROLL}Up ahead is the Resort Zone,{NEWLINE}with entertainment, leisure,{CLEAR}shopping, battling and catching{CLEAR}all in one place. It’s the perfect{CLEAR}spot for Trainers to relax.{SCROLL}It’s now officially open, so if{NEWLINE}you have time, go take a look!

strings.zh: 太好了！{NEWLINE}就在那里,{SCROLL}爬上楼梯,出去以后{NEWLINE}就只要走一点点路！
strings.en: All right!{NEWLINE}It’s just over there.{SCROLL}Go up the stairs, and you’ll be outside.{NEWLINE}Then it’s only a few paces away!

strings.zh: 明明就是很好的……
strings.en: It’s such a good deal, you know?

strings.zh: 对吧？狩猎很好吧。{SCROLL}啊,什么都不必说了吧,{NEWLINE}「真是超开心！」{CLEAR}都写在脸上了呢！
strings.en: See? The Safari Zone was fun?{NEWLINE}No need to say anything!{CLEAR}Your face says it was really fun!

strings.zh: 诶？{NEWLINE}你也想去度假区放松？{SCROLL}现在度假区还在进行最后的装修,{NEWLINE}再过不久就能开业了,{CLEAR}请在等一下吧！
strings.en: Huh? You want to go relax{NEWLINE}at the Resort Zone too?{SCROLL}The Resort Zone is still getting its{NEWLINE}finishing touches. It’ll open before{CLEAR}long, so please wait a little longer!

strings.zh: 很感谢您对度假区的期待,{NEWLINE}请再给我们一点时间,{CLEAR}很快就能开业了。
strings.en: Thank you so much for looking{NEWLINE}forward to the Resort Zone.{CLEAR}Please give us a little more{CLEAR}time. We’ll be open very soon.

strings.zh: 阿四『最后的练习内容是步法。{NEWLINE}学会用步法控制与对手的距离,{CLEAR}这在格斗中至关重要。{CLEAR}所以我选了拳速极快的艾比郎{CLEAR}做你们的练习对手,{CLEAR}你们要使用步法{CLEAR}控制与艾比郎的距离避免被打中,{CLEAR}明白了吗？
strings.en: Chuck: The last exercise is{NEWLINE}footwork. Learning to control the{CLEAR}distance to your opponent with{CLEAR}your footwork is vital in a fight.{SCROLL}So I’ve picked Hitmonchan, with{NEWLINE}its lightning-fast punches,{CLEAR}as your sparring partner.{SCROLL}Use your footwork to control{NEWLINE}your distance from Hitmonchan{CLEAR}and avoid getting hit. Got it?

strings.zh: 是！师傅！
strings.en: Yes, Master!

strings.zh: 阿四『好,大郎你先上,{NEWLINE}只使用前手刺拳攻击。
strings.en: Chuck: Right, Taro, you’re up{NEWLINE}first. Jabs with the lead hand only.
strings.notes: 大郎 → Taro (invented; 二郎 = Jiro from 0719 #831). In #16 Chuck names the two students 秀全 Seamus / 沙胜 Sandy (0719 #829/#828); the hack mixes the two naming schemes.

strings.zh: 轻松愉快的度假体验！{NEWLINE}宁静安详的休闲小镇！{SCROLL}位于48号路的度假区{NEWLINE}不久就会开张！
strings.en: A relaxing, cheerful getaway!{NEWLINE}A calm, peaceful leisure town!{SCROLL}The Resort Zone on Route 48{NEWLINE}is opening soon!

strings.zh: 轻松愉快的度假体验！{NEWLINE}宁静安详的休闲小镇！{SCROLL}位于48号路的度假区{NEWLINE}好评营业中！
strings.en: A relaxing, cheerful getaway!{NEWLINE}A calm, peaceful leisure town!{SCROLL}The Resort Zone on Route 48{NEWLINE}is open and a big hit!

strings.zh: 艾比郎『Hiii——mon！
strings.en: Hitmonchan: Hiii-mon!

strings.zh: 阿四『嗯……只躲开了1拳。{NEWLINE}好了,你们都回到原位置吧。
strings.en: Chuck: Hmm... Only dodged 1 punch. All{NEWLINE}right, both of you back to your places.

strings.zh: 阿四『现在轮到你了,二郎,{NEWLINE}也是只使用前手刺拳。
strings.en: Chuck: Now it’s your turn, Jiro.{NEWLINE}Lead-hand jabs only again.

strings.zh: 阿四『哦？能躲开3拳,不错不错。{NEWLINE}现在回到原位置吧。
strings.en: Chuck: Oh? Dodged 3 punches. Not{NEWLINE}bad, not bad. Now back to your place.

strings.zh: 阿四『刚才秀全比沙胜躲的拳更多,{NEWLINE}关键就在于秀全不局限于直线后退,{CLEAR}还使用了左右方向的移动摇闪。{CLEAR}只有让自己的步法变化多起来,{CLEAR}才能让对手捉摸不透打不中你,{CLEAR}知道了吗？
strings.en: Chuck: Seamus dodged more{NEWLINE}punches than Sandy just now. The{CLEAR}key is that Seamus didn’t just{CLEAR}back up in a straight line. He also{CLEAR}slipped and weaved left and right.{SCROLL}Only by varying your footwork can{NEWLINE}you keep your opponent guessing so{CLEAR}they can’t land a hit. Understand?

strings.zh: 知道了！师傅！
strings.en: Understood, Master!

strings.zh: 阿四『哟,那边的小哥,{NEWLINE}不要只看着了,过来一起练练吧。
strings.en: Chuck: Hey, young man over there!{NEWLINE}Don’t just watch. Come train with us!

strings.zh: 阿四『哟,那边的老妹,{NEWLINE}不要只看着了,过来一起练练吧。
strings.en: Chuck: Hey, young lady over there!{NEWLINE}Don’t just watch. Come train with us!

strings.zh: 阿四『我应该安排弟子{NEWLINE}守住了来这的路,{CLEAR}但是你依然出现在了这里,{CLEAR}就说明我的弟子们被你……
strings.en: Chuck: I had my students guard{NEWLINE}the way here, but you still showed{CLEAR}up. That means my students were...

strings.zh: 阿四『你不是联盟冠军{VAR:0103:0}大人吗！{SCROLL}阿四『哈哈哈哈,{NEWLINE}难怪我的弟子挡不住你。{CLEAR}今天是什么风把你给吹来了啊？
strings.en: Chuck: Aren’t you League{NEWLINE}Champion {VAR:0103:0}?!{SCROLL}Chuck: Hahahaha! No wonder my{NEWLINE}students couldn’t stop you.{CLEAR}What brings you here today?

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『我就只是刚好路过湛蓝市,{NEWLINE}顺道过来看看。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: I was just passing{NEWLINE}through Cianwood City, so{CLEAR}I thought I’d drop by.

strings.zh: 阿四『既然你在我们修行时出现,{NEWLINE}那这就是缘分。{CLEAR}不如就借着这个机会,{CLEAR}向我们展示一下你身为{CLEAR}最强训练家的身体素质怎么样啊？
strings.en: Chuck: You showed up during our{NEWLINE}training, so it must be fate.{SCROLL}Why not take this chance to show{NEWLINE}us what kind of physical condition{CLEAR}the strongest Trainer is in?

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『我的身体素质跟你们这种{NEWLINE}用人类肉身与口袋妖怪搏斗的人{CLEAR}完全没法比较,{CLEAR}没什么可展示的吧……
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: My body’s nothing compared{NEWLINE}to people like you, who wrestle{CLEAR}Pokémon with their own flesh and{CLEAR}blood. There’s nothing to show off...

strings.zh: 阿四『我身为格斗系精灵的专家,{NEWLINE}虽说在精灵对战方面{CLEAR}不如四天王的志霸先生,{CLEAR}但论起观察人的身体素质{CLEAR}绝对是无人能及。{CLEAR}我能够清楚地感受到{CLEAR}你在与精灵并肩作战时{CLEAR}已经锻炼出了远超常人的体质,{CLEAR}只是你自己不知道罢了。
strings.en: Chuck: As an expert on Fighting-type{NEWLINE}Pokémon, I may not match Mr. Bruno{CLEAR}of the Elite Four in Pokémon battles,{SCROLL}but when it comes to sizing{NEWLINE}up a person’s physique,{CLEAR}nobody can touch me.{SCROLL}I can clearly feel it: fighting{NEWLINE}side by side with your Pokémon{CLEAR}has already built you a body far{CLEAR}beyond an ordinary person’s.{CLEAR}You just don’t know it yourself.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『可是你们刚刚说的{NEWLINE}那些步法什么的,{CLEAR}我根本就不懂。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: But all that footwork{NEWLINE}stuff you were talking about...{CLEAR}I don’t understand it at all.

strings.zh: 阿四『那些都是格斗技巧,{NEWLINE}以你的身体素质来说,{CLEAR}可能根本就不需要这种技巧。{CLEAR}如果你对自己的身体还不够了解,{CLEAR}那就用我的方法{CLEAR}来确认一下自己的体质吧。
strings.en: Chuck: Those are fighting{NEWLINE}techniques. With a body like yours,{CLEAR}you probably don’t need them at all.{SCROLL}If you don’t know your own body well{NEWLINE}enough yet, then let’s use my method{CLEAR}to check what you’re made of.
{VAR:0103:0}: Your method...?

strings.zh: 阿四『哈哈,出来吧,铁掌力士！
strings.en: Chuck: Hahaha! Come on out, Hariyama!

strings.zh: 铁掌力士『Haaa——ri！
strings.en: Hariyama: Haaa-ri!

strings.zh: 阿四『这是我所有的精灵中{NEWLINE}力气最大的一只,{CLEAR}一巴掌就能打飞卡车,{CLEAR}我经常跟他玩角力游戏,{CLEAR}只不过总是输给它,哈哈哈哈。
strings.en: Chuck: This is the strongest{NEWLINE}of all my Pokémon. One slap{CLEAR}could send a truck flying!{SCROLL}We often play wrestling games together,{NEWLINE}only I always lose to it. Hahahaha!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『你想用铁掌力士干嘛？
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: What do you{NEWLINE}want to do with Hariyama?

strings.zh: 阿四『你来跟铁掌力士推推手,{NEWLINE}比比谁的力气更大。{CLEAR}这次只比力气,不用技巧。
strings.en: Chuck: I want you to go palm{NEWLINE}to palm with Hariyama and see{CLEAR}who’s stronger. This time it’s{CLEAR}pure strength, no technique.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『让我跟铁掌力士比力气！？{NEWLINE}你该不会是想要我的命吧？
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: You want me to test{NEWLINE}my strength against Hariyama?!{CLEAR}Are you trying to kill me?

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『让我跟铁掌力士比力气！？{NEWLINE}你该不会是火箭队派来暗杀我的吧？
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: You want me to test my{NEWLINE}strength against Hariyama?! Did Team{CLEAR}Rocket send you to assassinate me?

strings.zh: 阿四『哈哈哈哈,你说什么呢,{NEWLINE}我们湛蓝道馆的普通训练家{CLEAR}平时都是跟口袋妖怪对练的,{CLEAR}身为联盟冠军的你{CLEAR}怎么能被这种小事难住。
strings.en: Chuck: Hahahaha, what are you{NEWLINE}talking about? The ordinary{CLEAR}Trainers at our Cianwood Gym{CLEAR}spar with Pokémon all the time.{SCROLL}How could a little thing like this{NEWLINE}stop you, the League Champion?

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『不不不,{NEWLINE}我只是用精灵对战的冠军,{CLEAR}不与精灵对战的冠军。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: No, no, no. I’m a Champion{NEWLINE}who battles with Pokémon, not a{CLEAR}Champion who battles against Pokémon!

strings.zh: 阿四『看来说一万遍,{NEWLINE}不如让你亲身体会一遍。{CLEAR}上吧铁掌力士,{CLEAR}把咱们的冠军{VAR:0103:0}推到石壁那边去！
strings.en: Chuck: Looks like saying{NEWLINE}it ten thousand times won’t{CLEAR}beat letting you feel it once.{SCROLL}Go, Hariyama! Push our Champion{NEWLINE}{VAR:0103:0} over to that rock wall!
{VAR:0103:0}: Whoa, hey!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『可以了,不要再推了！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: OK, that’s{NEWLINE}enough! Stop pushing!

strings.zh: 阿四『好了,铁掌力士,回来吧！
strings.en: Chuck: All right, Hariyama, come back!
{VAR:0103:0}: Huff... huff...{NEWLINE}I’m about to collapse...

strings.zh: 阿四『虽然铁掌力士刚才没尽全力,{NEWLINE}但你最后能顶住它不后退,{CLEAR}就足以证明自己非凡的体质了。
strings.en: Chuck: Hariyama wasn’t going{NEWLINE}all out just now, but you held{CLEAR}your ground at the end without{CLEAR}backing up. That’s proof enough{CLEAR}of your extraordinary physique.
{VAR:0103:0}: Um, thanks...

strings.zh: 阿四『有一个传言说,{NEWLINE}真新镇这座未经污染的{CLEAR}纯白色小镇出身的训练家,{CLEAR}身体素质比一般人要好得多。{CLEAR}但像你这样能硬抗铁掌力士的体质,{CLEAR}即使在真新镇人中应该也极为罕见。
strings.en: Chuck: There’s a rumor that Trainers{NEWLINE}from Pallet Town, that pure white{CLEAR}town untouched by pollution, are in far{CLEAR}better physical shape than most people.{SCROLL}But a body that can stand up to{NEWLINE}Hariyama like yours must be extremely{CLEAR}rare even among Pallet Town folk.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『但也没必要用人类的肉身{NEWLINE}去承受精灵的力量啊……
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: But there’s no{NEWLINE}need to take on a Pokémon’s{CLEAR}power with a human body...

strings.zh: 阿四『我们道馆的理念,{NEWLINE}就是用身体去感受精灵的力量,{CLEAR}这样才能在对战中{CLEAR}与精灵取得最大程度的协同。{CLEAR}你只要与我来场对战,{CLEAR}就能感受到我们这样训练的意义了。
strings.en: Chuck: Our Gym’s philosophy is to{NEWLINE}feel a Pokémon’s power with your{CLEAR}own body. That’s how you reach{CLEAR}the greatest possible teamwork{CLEAR}with your Pokémon in battle.{SCROLL}Just battle me, and you’ll see{NEWLINE}what our kind of training means.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『如果是使用精灵对战,{NEWLINE}那我没有问题。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: If it’s a Pokémon battle,{NEWLINE}I’ve got no problem with that.

strings.zh: 阿四『很好,这才是我们的冠军{NEWLINE}该有的自信和从容。{CLEAR}现在我要拿出全力,{CLEAR}向你展示一下我们平时训练的成果！
strings.en: Chuck: Very good! That’s{NEWLINE}the confidence and composure{CLEAR}our Champion ought to have.{SCROLL}Now I’ll give it everything{NEWLINE}I’ve got and show you what{CLEAR}our training has achieved!

strings.zh: 阿四『啊呀呀！{NEWLINE}论起与精灵心意相通,{CLEAR}还是你更胜一筹。{CLEAR}看来有些东西并不是{CLEAR}通过身体碰撞就能领会的。{CLEAR}果然在训练家这条路上{CLEAR}我还有很多东西需要学习。
strings.en: Chuck: Wahhh! When it comes to{NEWLINE}being in tune with your Pokémon,{CLEAR}you’re still a cut above.{SCROLL}Some things can’t be learned just by{NEWLINE}clashing bodies, it seems. I still have a{CLEAR}lot to learn on the path of a Trainer.

strings.zh: 阿四『哈哈,能不断地学习和成长,{NEWLINE}这也是你强大的原因吧。{CLEAR}谢谢你向我和我的弟子们{CLEAR}展示了冠军的战斗方式,{CLEAR}我现在要带他们回湛蓝道馆{CLEAR}好好消化一下今天学到的东西。{CLEAR}冠军大人以后有时间的话,{CLEAR}欢迎来湛蓝道馆找我切磋啊！
strings.en: Chuck: Hahaha! Always{NEWLINE}learning and growing, that{CLEAR}must be why you’re so strong.{SCROLL}Thank you for showing my students{NEWLINE}and me how a Champion battles. Now{CLEAR}I’ll take them back to the Cianwood{CLEAR}Gym to digest what we learned today.{SCROLL}Champion, if you ever have time, come by{NEWLINE}the Cianwood Gym for a sparring match!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『不……{NEWLINE}跟你的精灵比过力气之后,{CLEAR}我似乎也更能了解自己精灵的想法了。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: No... After testing my{NEWLINE}strength against your Pokémon, I think{CLEAR}I understand what my own Pokémon{CLEAR}are thinking a little better too.

strings.zh: 阿四『撑住啊冠军大人！{NEWLINE}撑不住的话就要被推到石壁上挤扁了！
strings.en: Chuck: Hang in there, Champion!{NEWLINE}If you can’t hold out, you’ll be{CLEAR}squashed flat against the rock wall!

strings.zh: 阿金『偶像,我刚刚挑战湛蓝道馆时,{NEWLINE}听阿四馆主说西边的度假区开业了。{CLEAR}咱们出来旅行这么久,{CLEAR}不是在收集徽章就是在对付火箭队,{CLEAR}也该找个地方好好歇歇了。{CLEAR}偶像也别把自己搞得那么累,{CLEAR}一起去度假区玩玩吧！
strings.en: Gold: Idol, when I challenged{NEWLINE}the Cianwood Gym just now, Gym{CLEAR}Leader Chuck said the Resort{CLEAR}Zone to the west has opened.{SCROLL}We’ve been traveling for so long,{NEWLINE}and it’s been nothing but collecting{CLEAR}Badges or dealing with Team{CLEAR}Rocket. It’s about time we found{CLEAR}somewhere to take a proper break.{SCROLL}Don’t wear yourself out so much{NEWLINE}either, Idol. Let’s go have{CLEAR}some fun at the Resort Zone!

strings.zh: 从这里到度假区还有很远吧？{NEWLINE}光是爬这个台阶我就要累死了。
strings.en: Is it still a long way from here to the{NEWLINE}Resort Zone? Just climbing these stairs{CLEAR}is killing me.
